name: Colorlight Cloud Tech Ltd
summary: Colorlight Cloud Tech Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of LED display control systems, video processing equipment, and cloud network players in China and internationally. It offers Z-series super processors, X-series processors, S-series senders, receiving cards, multifunction cards, brightness sensors, and temperature and humidity sensors.
